title: SWF compile: DebugId (tag 63) not emitted — 16-byte debug UUID missing from published SWFs
description: Tag 63 (DebugId) is never emitted by compile.ts. Flash Professional emits this tag containing a 16-byte UUID when ActionScript debugging is enabled. EnableDebugger2 (tag 64) IS implemented. DebugId should be emitted alongside it when the doc's debug flag is set, or always as a fixed zero UUID for compatibility. Tag body is just 16 bytes of UUID data.
